chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'A calamity of the lineage is pride.'
ai.seo_question: What is considered the calamity of lineage in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits the Prophet’s (PBUH) teaching that the true corruption of lineage lies not in its quality, but in the arrogance of boasting about it. This highlights the Shia ethical emphasis on humility (tawadu) over genealogical pride, a theme central to the chapter on arrogance. It serves as a reminder that spiritual worth supersedes ancestral status.
